# TVET Lipis — AI Crawler Reference

## Organisation
Name: Akademi Pembangunan Kemahiran USIM Kuala Lipis (TVET Lipis)
Also known as: Kolej Islam Antarabangsa Kuala Lipis, KIAK Kuala Lipis
Accreditation: JPK K16005
Type: Private vocational college (TVET)
Location: Level 4, Lipis Centrepoint, Jalan Pekeliling, 27200 Kuala Lipis, Pahang, Malaysia
Website: https://tvetlipis.my
Contact: 016-446 6630 | admission.tvetlipis@gmail.com

## Programs Offered
Active programs:
1. Diploma Pendidikan Awal Kanak-Kanak (T982:001-4:2018)
2. Diploma Multimedia (IT-070-4:2011)
3. Sijil Pemasangan & Penyelenggaraan Elektrik (F432-005-3:2019)
4. Diploma Pentadbiran & Pendidikan Pra-Sekolah (J582-001-3:2019)

Coming soon: Diploma Kulinari, Diploma Cyber Security

## Entry Requirements
- Age: 16-35 years
- Education: PT3 / SPM / STPM / Tahfiz / Pondok
- Funding: PTPK PLK-i available

## PPT Program
Duration: 6 months | Fee: RM 4,000 | Age: 18+ (SKM), 21+ (DKM)
Programs: Pentadbiran Pejabat, Pendidikan Awal Kanak-Kanak, Pendidikan Pra-Sekolah

## FAQs
Q: Is TVET Lipis recognised by JPK? A: Yes, JPK K16005.
Q: Is PTPK funding available? A: Yes, PLK-i scheme.
Q: What is PPT? A: Recognition of prior work experience — 6 months to DKM.
Q: Office hours? A: Monday-Saturday 9am-6pm.
